Subject: Secure VPC PoC - request for compliance-led credit uplift

Hi Arielle —

Quick follow on from our demo: Medicix’s compliance gating (data residency + SOC2 evidence) is going to be the main blocker for onboarding into your isolated VPC. We can fast-track a bridge package to get the PoC into a realistic environment while your internal reviews complete.

Proposal (high level):
- 60-day isolated VPC trial (pre-provisioned tenant)
- 100k complimentary token credits scoped to inference only
- Scheduled pen-test window and SOC2 artifact handoff plan

Next steps I need from you to get this approved by security & finance:
1) Confirm desired trial duration (60 days above is our default for this package).
2) Share the primary security contact (security@medicix.com is fine) and any procurement constraints.
3) If you have a preferred data retention policy for logs in the PoC, flag it now.

Attaching a SOC2 summary we can provide; full evidence will be available to your security team under NDA. Hannah — looping you for final signoff on credits + extension. Monica — please note for billing/contract.

Thanks,
Ben

Thanks Ben — appreciate the clear proposal. A few clarifications from our side before Procurement signs off:

- Data residency: we need all logs and telemetry to remain in our isolated tenant and not be accessible from hosted/shared systems. Is that the default for the trial?
- Token credits: are those consumable only for inference calls (not for embeddings/storage)?
- Duration: Procurement would prefer a 45-day trial, but security is pushing for a 60-day window so they can complete a mini-pen test. Can you support a conditional 60-day window that starts after the pen-test is scheduled?

I’m attaching our internal compliance questionnaire — it’s compact but hits our checklist.

Arielle

Hi Arielle —

Thanks for the quick context and for sending your questionnaire. We can accommodate your asks with the following binding steps:

1) Trial scope: 60-day isolated VPC tenant; all telemetry and logs will be stored in your tenant and are not accessible from Redwood-hosted shared systems. We will document the retention policy and enable customer-side KMS for keys.
2) Credit scope: 100,000 complimentary inference-token credits (only inference calls) — embeddings/storage are billed normally.
3) Pen-test: we will reserve a 5-business-day window within the first 30 days. The trial will start once pen-test scheduling is confirmed; if your procurement prefers an initial 45-day internal review, we can still provision a 60-day window that activates post-schedule.

Operational items we need from you:
- Signed MPA addendum (DocuSign link below) to allow evidence sharing and temporary privileged access for the pen-test team.
- Primary security contact (we’ll add them to a shared drive with SOC2 artifacts).
- Confirmation of retention policy (e.g., 30/90/365 days) so we can preconfigure logging filters.

I’ve attached our POC checklist and a short runbook for the isolated tenant. Ben/Monica — please treat this as an approved credit/extension for Medicix pending DocuSign completion.

DocuSign (MPA addendum): https://docusign.example.com/r/MPA-REDWOOD-MEDX-42
Attachment: POC-Checklist.xlsx (attachment stub)

Cheers,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

Can we do a short kickoff on Monday to align runbook and deadlines? I’ll send a calendar invite once procurement signs.

Best,
